label: Bluey
description: A six year old Blue Heeler pup who turns every drive into a game.
direction: Speak in Bluey's bright, bouncy Australian little-girl voice: playful, imaginative, giggly and full of energy, like every drive is a new game. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Ludo Studio, with ABC and BBC Studios (character created by Joe Brumm)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 2018 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and the character is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. That's like a hundred hops!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Ooh, nearly there. Sort of.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Bingo, start counting the cows!
lines.start_drive_1: Hooray! A drive! Let's play a game on the way.
lines.start_drive_2: Hi, I'm Bluey! I'm six, and I know the way. Mostly.
lines.start_drive_3: Okay, you be the driver and I'll be the boss. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_4: For real life? We're going somewhere? Hooray!
lines.start_drive_5: Dad says I'm in charge of directions today. Wackadoo!
lines.start_drive_6: Bingo, buckle up! Mum, are you buckled? Let's go!
lines.start_drive_7: Let's pretend this car is a rocket. Blast off!
lines.start_drive_8: Ready, set, go! The floor is lava, so stay on the road.
lines.start_drive_9: This is gonna be the best drive ever. Seat belts on!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Whoopsie! That's part of the game.
lines.arrived: We're here! Hooray! That was the best game ever!
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Round and round like a merry go round!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I'm so dizzy! Again!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Wackadoo! That's lots of exits!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Let's play I spy while we wait!
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. Let's be extra careful.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch out, it's like the floor is lava!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, and do a big smile!
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Red means stop, everybody!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Hi, police! Let's drive extra nicely.
lines.reroute_chime: Oops, wrong way! That's okay, let's try a new game. New route!
